values.meaning: bonus attack speed per stack, by level
values.binNote: Wiki rounds the pplevel curve to two decimals (10 to 25); bin's byLevel(10..25) interpolation carries more decimal precision (e.g. 10.882353 vs 10.88). Same underlying curve, precision differs.

values.meaning: bonus magic on-hit damage at max stacks
values.binNote: Flat base by level = OnHitBaseDamage(10) + OnHitPerLevel(3) x (level-1), giving 10..61, matching the wiki's pplevel|10 to 61. The 0.2 bonus AD coefficient is stated directly in IreliaPassive#OnHitBonus (+0.2xbonus ad); its flat term {b22609db} is an unresolved bin reference presumed to be the by-level base above.

values.quote: reduced to{{ft|50%|{{as|{{pplevel|10*0.5 to 61*0.5}}|magic damage}} {{as|(+ {{ap|20*0.5}}% '''bonus''' AD)}}}}against structures
values.binNote: OnHitStructureMod=0.5 is the multiplier applied to the p_onhit base and coefficient (10..61 x0.5 = 5..30.5, 0.2 x0.5 = 0.1), matching the wiki's stated 50% reduction against structures.

No MarkDuration row exists under the P (IreliaPassive) slot in the sheet; IreliaE.MarkDuration and IreliaR.MarkDuration (both 5) belong to the E/R slots that apply the mark, not to this passive's own data block.

mechanics.claim: Irelia's abilities generate a stack for each enemy champion hit, or one stack if she hits at least one non-champion.
mechanics.quote: abilities generate a {{tip|stack}} of ''Ionian Fervor'' for each enemy champion hit, as well as one stack if she hits at least one non-champion.

mechanics.claim: Basic attacks and ability hits against enemy champions, large monsters, and structures refresh the stack duration.
mechanics.quote: refreshing on {{tip|basic attacks}} and ability hits against enemy {{tip|champions}}, large {{tip|monster|monsters}}, and {{tip|structures}}

mechanics.claim: At maximum stacks, basic attacks deal bonus on-hit magic damage.
mechanics.quote: At maximum stacks, '''Irelia's''' basic attacks are empowered to deal {{as|{{pplevel|10 to 61}}|magic damage}} {{as|(+ 20% '''bonus''' AD)}} {{as|'''bonus''' magic damage}} {{tip|on-hit}}

mechanics.claim: The bonus on-hit damage is reduced to 50% against structures.
mechanics.quote: reduced to{{ft|50%|{{as|{{pplevel|10*0.5 to 61*0.5}}|magic damage}} {{as|(+ {{ap|20*0.5}}% '''bonus''' AD)}}}}against structures

mechanics.claim: Ionian Fervor will not deal damage if the attack misses due to blind, but its duration will still refresh.
mechanics.quote: ''Ionian Fervor'' will not deal damage if the attack misses due to {{tip|blind}}, but its duration will be refreshed.

mechanics.claim: Enemy champions and large monsters hit by Flawless Duet's or Vanguard's Edge's initial barrage are marked as Unsteady, consumable by Bladesurge.
mechanics.quote: Enemy {{tip|champions}} and large {{tip|monster|monsters}} hit by ''{{ai|Flawless Duet|Irelia}}'' or ''{{ais|Vanguard's Edge|Irelia}}'' initial barrage are {{as|marked|buzzword}} as ''Unsteady'' for 5 seconds. The mark can be consumed by ''{{ai|Bladesurge|Irelia}}''.
